row.evidence: Mattermost's Okta SAML guide says provisioning and deprovisioning of SAML users "relies on AD/LDAP to do so. Currently, we do not support SCIM."
row.notes: Status changed from partial (June) to none: the docs state explicitly that SCIM is not supported, and under the September rules vendor-run AD/LDAP sync is directory sync, not SCIM. Lifecycle automation is SAML JIT plus AD/LDAP sync (deactivates users and revokes sessions), which the docs place on Entry, Enterprise and Enterprise Advanced but not Professional. Price change: the pricing page no longer lists $10/u/mo for Professional; all paid tiers are now Contact Sales / Get Pricing / Request Quote, so the June $10 figures are dropped (no first-party source). SAML SSO is documented on Entry (free, limited-use edition of Enterprise Advanced for evaluation), Professional, Enterprise and Enterprise Advanced. Seats are licensed per activated (not deactivated) user. Self-hosted product; REST API v4 on all offerings.

plans.name: Entry
plans.price_text: Free (limited-use edition of Enterprise Advanced for technical evaluation)

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: AD/LDAP sync not available on Professional per docs.

limitations.text: SAML alone does not update attributes or deprovision; SAML must be paired with AD/LDAP sync, which is not on Professional.

scim.notes: Explicit vendor statement: 'Currently, we do not support SCIM.' Deprovisioning relies on AD/LDAP sync.

capabilities.notes: manage_groups = team membership; delete_user permanent only with permanent=true and EnableAPIUserDeletion.

audit_log_api.notes: GET /api/v4/audits needs manage_system permission; plan gating not stated on the reference page.

okta.notes: Mattermost's guide creates a new SAML 2.0 app in Okta; no OIN listing found at okta.com/integrations/mattermost (404).

entra.notes: Non-gallery enterprise application per Mattermost's guide; Entra tutorial URL 404.

onelogin.notes: Uses OneLogin's generic SAML Test Connector (Advanced).

fallbacks.other_sync: AD/LDAP user and group sync (Entry, Enterprise, Enterprise Advanced): deactivates users disabled in AD/LDAP and revokes sessions
fallbacks.notes: SAML and AD/LDAP first sign-in both auto-create accounts; OIDC JIT not verified.

citations.title: SAML Single Sign-On
citations.quote: Mattermost user accounts are automatically created the first time a user signs in with their SAML credentials on the Mattermost server.

citations.title: SAML Single Sign-On
citations.quote: SAML Single sign-on itself does not support periodic updates of user attributes nor automatic deprovisioning. However, SAML with AD/LDAP sync can be configured to support these use cases.

citations.title: AD/LDAP setup
citations.quote: Available on Entry, Enterprise, and Enterprise Advanced plans (not available on Professional)

citations.title: AD/LDAP setup
citations.quote: When accounts are disabled in AD/LDAP users are deactivated in Mattermost, and their active sessions are revoked once Mattermost synchronizes the updated attributes.

citations.title: Create a user
citations.quote: Create a new user on the system. Password is required for email login. For other authentication types such as LDAP or SAML, auth_data and auth_service fields are required.

citations.title: Deactivate a user account.
citations.quote: Deactivates the user and revokes all its sessions by archiving its user object.

citations.title: Activate or deactivate a user
citations.quote: Activate or deactivate a user's account. A deactivated user can't log into Mattermost or use it without being reactivated.

citations.title: Patch a user

citations.title: Update a user's roles

citations.title: Get audits

citations.title: Add user to team
